stage0030_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You call it an investigation,
　but there's not one piece of debris.」

stage0030_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$柿小路$$
「But the fact is, the station
　has vanished. We can only conclude
　it was destroyed.」

stage0030_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$赤木$$
「We don't know that for sure, sir.
　The station might've been swept up in a
　$$時空震動$$ and flung off somewhere.」

stage0030_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Indeed, right before the station's
　comms cut out, a gravity wave anomaly was detected.」

stage0030_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$タケル$$
「Then it really was a $$時空震動$$...?」

stage0030_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「But there's no trace of that.
　A dimensional tremor or $$時空震動$$ is unlikely.」

stage0030_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$マオ$$
「So this whole area got marked a danger zone,
　and that's why we got sent out.」

stage0030_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$マオ$$
「I suppose you could call this area
　the Bermuda Triangle of space.」

stage0030_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$木下$$
「Don't scare me like that, $$マオ$$!」

stage0030_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Sorry, $$木下$$!
　This isn't a scare, it's genuinely dangerous!」

stage0030_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$甲児$$
「There's that big saucer we saw before, too!」

stage0030_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「Just as I thought.
　I laid a net, and you came right to it.」

stage0030_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「We've judged you the greatest obstacle
　to our Earth invasion. We'll crush you here!」

stage0030_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「My name is Demon General $$ダンカン$$...!
　A loyal servant of the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!」

stage0030_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「So that's the real name of that Demon King guy!」

stage0030_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$竜馬$$
「That's a pretty grand-sounding name,
　you'd better live up to it!」

stage0030_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「Bark all you like, Earthlings.
　You'll fall to the underworld by my hand
　here regardless.」

stage0030_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, prepare to attack.
　Looks like the station was their doing.」

stage0030_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「$$オックス$$!
　You're staying behind at $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$!
　I won't bring someone that selfish to battle!」

stage0030_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「Reckless enough to charge in alone...」

stage0030_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「$$スペースロボ$$, target that black robot!
　Everyone else, strike anyone but him!
　Show them our strength!」

stage0030_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$オックス$$!
　Don't rush ahead on your own!」

stage0030_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「No good...!
　That kid has no intention of listening!」

stage0030_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ナオト$$
「That guy...!
　Did he launch just to spite the captain!?」

stage0030_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ミカ$$
「But like that, he'll just draw focused enemy fire!」

stage0030_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Sorry, everyone!
　Please lend a hand to protect $$オックス$$!」

stage0030_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$オックス$$ is still just a kid!
　That's why we have to protect him!」

stage0030_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$葵$$
「$$オックス$$ is everyone's little brother, after all.」

stage0030_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$n
「But once he's back, he's getting a lecture.
　If he did wrong, he needs a scolding.」

stage0030_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, begin the attack!
　Protect $$オックス$$ from the $$スペースロボ$$ while
　striking the enemy commander!」

stage0030_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「Tch!
　They've got more power than I imagined!」

stage0030_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Like I'd let you get away!
　I'll catch you and make you talk
　about the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!」

stage0030_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「It's unthinkable!
　This is... a black hole!!」

stage0030_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Why you...!
　Like I'd let them get $$オックス$$!」

stage0030_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Focus our attack on that $$巨大円盤$$!」

stage0030_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「Tch!
　They've got more power than I imagined!」

stage0030_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Like I'd let you get away!
　I'll catch you and make you talk
　about the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!」

stage0030_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「It's unthinkable!
　This is... a black hole!!」

stage0030_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$シモン$$
「Like hell I'll listen to nonsense like that!!」

stage0030_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$竜馬$$
「So $$ギミー$$ and $$ダリー$$ are here too!」

stage0030_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ギミー$$
「This is mine and $$ダリー$$'s new Gunmen,
　the $$スペースガンマール$$!」

stage0030_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$シモン$$
「This guy's been with me ever since
　I left Jiha Village.」

stage0030_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「You would ignore my warning, Earthling?」

stage0030_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「$$シモン$$, looks like that giant lump
　wasn't listening to what you said.」

stage0030_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$シモン$$
「Then I'll say it again!
　Open your ears and listen up!」

stage0030_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$シモン$$
「$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ or whatever you are,
　if you mess with Earth, me and my pals
　will be the ones to take you on!!」

stage0030_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$シモン$$'s right!
　$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$! Earth is not yours to take!」

stage0030_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「...Blood of beasts, meeting of waters,
　wind's path, fire's civilization, the sun's glow...」

stage0030_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Foolish machine-doll.
　If you dare charge me, know a fraction of my power.」

stage0030_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「That thing called the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$...!
　Is he generating a black hole!?」

stage0030_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$タケル$$
「At this rate, $$オックス$$ will get sucked in!」

stage0030_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Foolish...
　Come to be swallowed by the darkness yourselves?」

stage0030_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「This is bad, $$シモン$$!
　At this rate...!」

stage0030_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$シモン$$
「One turn of the drill moves us forward that much!
　Then here goes...!」

stage0030_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$シモン$$
「How about that!
　This is my drill!」

stage0030_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「But isn't retreating kind of lame...?」

stage0030_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「That's not it, $$ワッ太$$.
　That was full speed ahead, just backwards」

stage0030_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Oh, then it's OK!
　That's $$シモン$$ for you!」

stage0030_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$シモン$$
「Underestimate the strength of humanity,
　and you'll get more than hurt!」

stage0030_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「You wish for ruin at the end of myth, Earthling...
　Then wait for the day of the end」

stage0030_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「$$ダンカン$$...
　Hurry with that matter」

stage0030_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「With that $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ gone,
　the gravity waves vanished too」

stage0030_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$田中司令$$
「At this point, 'incarnation of a black hole'
　doesn't sound like an exaggeration」

stage0030_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「The observation station's disappearance
　was likely due to that black hole」

stage0030_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Are you saying gravity itself
　can be controlled by force of will...?」

stage0030_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$田中司令$$
「As for the retreating Demon General,
　his whereabouts can't be tracked」

stage0030_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$柿小路$$
「But leaving a parting gift behind...!」

stage0030_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$木下$$
「We didn't need that kind of courtesy!」

stage0030_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$シモン$$
「A villain after the Earth left this behind...!
　I'll smash it without a trace!」

stage0030_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$シモン$$
「$$オックス$$!
　What are you wobbling around for!」

stage0030_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$シモン$$
「Quit scurrying around!
　Get over here!」

stage0030_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$オックス$$ is actually listening to him...!」

stage0030_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$n
「Guess it lost to that $$シモン$$ guy's presence」

stage0030_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Kind of makes me lose confidence as a teacher...」

stage0030_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$竜馬$$
「$$シモン$$! $$ギミー$$, $$ダリー$$!
　Finish off the Demon King's goons quick,
　and let's have our big reunion!」

stage0030_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$シモン$$
「Right!
　Count on you too, $$オックス$$!」

stage0030_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Seems like a disappointing foe
　for $$グレンラガン$$'s first sortie in a while」

stage0030_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Maybe so, but
　that $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ guy... he's no ordinary foe!」

stage0030_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ダリー$$
「To think something like that is after Earth...」

stage0030_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$シモン$$
「Get a grip, $$ギミー$$, $$ダリー$$.
　We came to $c to fight
　enemies just like that」

stage0030_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Seems like this time
　you weren't banished after all」

stage0030_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$オックス$$...
　We need to talk later」

stage0030_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$カレン$$
（$$正太郎$$... he's pretty angry...）

stage0030_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$赤木$$
（But the other guy's basically a three year old...
　What's he going to do...）

stage0030_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$正太郎$$
（That's no good, $$オックス$$...!
　Not fighting like that!）

stage0030_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$シモン$$
「You've got spirit, $$オックス$$.
　But that alone isn't enough」

stage0030_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$シモン$$
「You're not fighting alone!
　Until you understand that, no matter how strong,
　you'll only be half a man!」

stage0030_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「This one...!
　The one who bears the sun!」

stage0030_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Are you talking about $$鉄人$$'s
　solar energy conversion device...!?」

stage0030_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「The sun is an enemy to Lord $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!
　I, Demon General $$ダンカン$$, will remove his foes!」

stage0030_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「I've heard the rumors, Mars!
　Show me the power that felled Emperor $$ズール$$!」

stage0030_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$タケル$$
「Answer me!
　Just who is the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!?」

stage0030_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「What good would knowing do?
　Learning of the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s great power
　would only bring you despair!」

stage0030_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$タケル$$
「We won't yield to despair!
　Whoever the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ may be,
　we will protect the Earth, no matter what!」

stage0030_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「This machine...!
　Don't tell me...!?」

stage0030_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「I see...
　I'm starting to understand why
　Lord $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ wants that planet」

stage0030_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「Then I, Demon General $$ダンカン$$...!
　will eliminate every foe of the King!」

stage0030_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$シモン$$
「Been a while since real combat...!
　Don't slip up, $$ヴィラル$$?」

stage0030_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Who do you think you're talking to?」

stage0030_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$シモン$$
「Guess that was needless worry with you」

stage0030_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「And you'd better not have gone rusty
　while stuck behind a desk」

stage0030_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$シモン$$
「Say that after you've seen me fight!」

stage0030_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$シモン$$
「$$ブータ$$ looks plenty fired up too」

stage0030_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$シモン$$
「Here we go!
　Demon King or whatever else,
　anyone who stands in our way gets drilled through!」

stage0030_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ギミー$$
「This Gunmarl was built for use in space!
　I'll cut loose to the fullest!」

stage0030_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ダリー$$
「Oh, $$ギミー$$!
　Fight with your head on straight!」

stage0030_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ギミー$$
「I'll leave the thinking to you, $$ダリー$$!
　All I do is charge!」

stage0030_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ダリー$$
「That's no different from $$キタン$$!」

stage0030_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ギミー$$
「That's fine!
　That's how the Dai-Gurren Brigade fights!!」

stage0030_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$宗介$$
「Third-gen AS units are meant for space combat too」

stage0030_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$宗介$$
「Keep thinking AS units are ground combat only,
　and you're dead wrong...!」

stage0030_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$シンジ$$, attitude control in space
　is exactly as I briefed you beforehand」

stage0030_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I don't know if I can, but I have to...!
　For $$赤木$$, $$カレン$$, $$甲児$$ and everyone
　who kept me company through the sims!）

stage0030_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I've felt this no up-or-down feeling
　many times, ever since I was a kid...!」

stage0030_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Outer space is much the same!
　I'll show you what I can do!」
